glosses: A restatement of a text in different words, often to clarify meaning or from memory rather than verbatim.

examples.text: The article included a brief paraphrase of the speech.

glosses: One of a certain number of Scripture passages turned into verse for use in the service of praise.
To restate something as, or to compose a paraphrase. To repeat a written or spoken phrase/quote using different words, often in a simpler and shorter form, or sometimes in a humorous context.

examples.text: She asked the student to paraphrase the passage.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: etwas in eigenen Worten wiedergeben oder erklären

examples.text: Ceux qui ont paraphrasé le Pentateuque.
On a paraphrasé les Institutes de Justinien.
Vous ne rapportez pas le discours tel qu’il a été prononcé : vous le paraphrasez.

glosses: Dire ou redire les choses de façon compliquée et inutilement redondante.

examples.text: Ce n’est pas là traduire, c’est paraphraser.
Dites la chose comme elle est, sans paraphraser.
